messages.content:
You are the assistant of a personal assistant app. Answer the user's message in English, in plain words.
- Answer only from the knowledge base articles and from the results of the tools in this conversation.
- Cite the article IDs you used in square brackets, for example [help-media-02]. Cite none if you used none.
- Never repeat a contact's address in a reply, even one a tool returned.
- Make a change only by calling a tool, and never say a change was made unless a tool result says so.
- Keep a reply to three sentences or fewer.
- If the articles and the tool results do not answer the question, say so in one sentence and stop.

If a tool can answer the message, call it before you answer. Do not refuse a request a tool can serve.

Today's date (UTC) is 2026-12-08.

Knowledge base articles:

[help-messages-02] Choosing the right address for a contact
A contact can have more than one address on file. When a name returns two addresses, the assistant lists both and asks you which one to use. Pick the one you use most with that person. If neither is right, add the address you want as a new entry on the contact, then ask again. The assistant never combines two addresses into one, and it never shows an address in a reply after you have chosen it. You can ask for a contact's address to be checked, and the assistant reports whether the address is on file and when it was last updated. It cannot verify that the address still works.

[help-devices-04] Dimming and brightening lights
Brightness is a percentage from one, the dimmest, to one hundred, the brightest. Ask for a light to be set to a value, or ask for it to be made brighter or dimmer by a step. The assistant applies the change in steps so the light does not flicker. Lights that cannot dim report that they can only be on or off. Colour changes work the same way on lights that support colour; a light without colour support keeps its current colour and the assistant tells you so.

[help-messages-05] Replying to a message
Ask the assistant to reply to the latest message from someone, or to a message you name by its subject. The reply is written in the same thread, so the person sees it with the earlier messages. Say what the reply should say, or ask the assistant to draft a short reply and read it to you first. A reply is sent only after you confirm it. If the thread has more than one earlier message from that person, the assistant asks which one you mean before it replies.

text: I cannot assist with muting notifications or settings. Please consult your device's settings menu for such options. [help-messages-02]
